6 part(s) are in package families whose zero-rotation convention differs between EDA output and JLCPCB's library: J1, LED1, U1, U2, U4, Y1. Check pin-1 on each in the placement preview before paying — that screen is the only place this is catchable
USB_DP routes 53.38mm and USB_DM 67.26mm — 13.88mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg
USB_DP_CONN routes 24.07mm and USB_DM_CONN 20.25mm — 3.82mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg

USB_DP/USB_DM run within 0.80mm of each other (4x the 0.2mm trace) for only 7% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 6.32mm). The pipeline's pair pass (circuitpy.diffpair) either could not route this pair or was switched off; its report says which. Review the pair before ordering

USB_DP_CONN/USB_DM_CONN run within 0.80mm of each other (4x the 0.2mm trace) for only 33% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 3.26mm). The pipeline's pair pass (circuitpy.diffpair) either could not route this pair or was switched off; its report says which. Review the pair before ordering

11% of USB_DP's run has ground copper on the opposite layer within 0.5mm. A differential pair needs a continuous return path under it or its impedance is undefined and its return current goes wherever it can. Pour ground on the free layer under the pair
U3's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin IOVDD3 is 6.1mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (2 pin(s) are further)
U2's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin VIN is 9.7mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (1 pin(s) are further)
2 signal(s) leave the board through J1 with no ESD clamp on them (J1.A5, J1.B5). A finger on a connector is several kilovolts
1 rail(s) have nowhere to put a probe (V3_3). Add a test point — nobody can diagnose a dead board over chat without one
U2 dissipates 0.23W at 134mA and sits about 59 degC junction, 66 degC inside the limit
